requirements.statement: The authoritative framework namespace SHALL have one machine-resolvable identity whose concrete filesystem placement is defined by repository configuration.
FS0 SHALL contain exactly one foundational Framework Contract authority.
The Framework Contract SHALL explicitly delegate to Governance, Conformance, and Assurance.
Every accepted authority SHALL have a stable machine-resolvable identity.
Every independently governed semantic invariant SHALL have exactly one controlling normative authority owner.
Every filesystem object beneath the repository root SHALL require applicable positive authorization from the canonical repository-structure configuration.

Implementation, validation output, review findings, generated artifacts, workflow convention, historical state, product behavior, and technical write capability SHALL NOT independently create normative authority.
Normative authority dependencies SHALL be acyclic.
Every maintained derived framework primitive SHALL have resolvable provenance to accepted normative authority.
Each accepted normative obligation SHALL be represented by an identified requirement with owner, statement, lifecycle state, lineage where applicable, and Conformance and Assurance applicability.

Bootstrap SHALL initialize the target Git repository when absent and create the first local commit containing the complete initial FS0 candidate; bootstrap SHALL NOT create the GitHub repository, publish remote state, or establish user credentials.

Before local bootstrap mutation, bootstrap SHALL verify required local Git and execution capabilities; GitHub remote, authentication, network, and publication capabilities SHALL NOT be prerequisites to construction of the initial local FS0 candidate.

The operating substrate SHALL provide Git operations, authenticated GitHub API access, HTTPS/TLS and name resolution, maintained-script execution, remote Conformance evidence retrieval, and accepted-state publication.
Authentication secrets, tokens, private keys, and equivalent credentials SHALL remain external to repository-maintained state.
GitHub SHALL be the required initial FS0 operating platform.

FS0 SHALL support repository read/write; Git ref read/create/update; issue and pull-request operations; workflow/check and commit/status reads; event-driven workflow execution; and authenticated actor resolution.
Bootstrap SHALL generate the required repository-orientation and license surfaces at configuration-authorized locations.
Canonical repository-orientation surfaces SHALL remain subordinate operational surfaces and SHALL NOT become independent semantic owners.
The bootstrap prototype and initial installed FS0 SHALL use GNU General Public License version 3 unless later accepted Governance changes that decision where legally permitted.
The retained bootstrap payload SHALL contain only Design input, canonical realization inputs, and implementation required to construct, verify, accept, cut over, and maintain FS0.
Generated artifacts SHALL remain semantically distinct from non-authoritative bootstrap maintenance source and SHALL require structural authorization at their configured locations.
FS0 SHALL expose exactly one canonical bootstrap invocation surface that is machine-resolvable from repository state.
The canonical bootstrap invocation surface SHALL contain only invocation concerns and delegate substantive behavior to separately identified implementation.
Once copied into the target repository, the bootstrap payload SHALL require no semantic, template, generator, or script input from the originating bootstrap environment.
Bootstrap SHALL install the complete successor repo-spec Design Proposal seed set before cutover.
Each installed successor Design Proposal SHALL have one canonical structured read representation.
After cutover, authoritative determination SHALL use accepted authoritative read surfaces and SHALL NOT use non-authoritative bootstrap maintenance source as fallback authority.
FS0 SHALL retain one machine-resolvable non-authoritative bootstrap maintenance-source and generation role after cutover.
Exactly one canonical repository-structure configuration SHALL be the sole instance-level source of filesystem permission beneath the repository root.
A present filesystem object beneath the repository root without applicable positive structural authorization SHALL cause Conformance failure.
The bootstrap lifecycle SHALL permit only candidate -> cutover and no reverse transition.
After cutover, bootstrap maintenance machinery SHALL NOT independently authorize mutation or create acceptance.

After cutover, FS0 SHALL complete bounded self-change through accepted authority, candidate publication, Conformance, Assurance, explicit acceptance, and accepted-state publication without the external bootstrap environment.
Every FS0 JSON record SHALL contain schema_version and record_type.
Each FS0 authority record SHALL contain schema_version, record_type authority, authority_id, title, owner, lifecycle_state, dependencies, delegates, requirements, and provenance.
Each installed requirement record SHALL contain requirement_id, owner_authority_id, statement, lifecycle_state, lineage where applicable, conformance_applicability, and assurance_applicability.
FS0 SHALL maintain one machine-resolvable bootstrap state record containing lifecycle state, bootstrap provenance issue when established, accepted ref, and cutover timestamp when established.

The canonical repository-orientation surface SHALL state repository purpose, bootstrap/cutover status, Design Proposal discovery, accepted-state discovery, operation guidance, and limits on implementation/GitHub authority.
The canonical agent-orientation surface SHALL state initial reading order, Design-chunk discovery, bootstrap/cutover-state discovery, and accepted-state resolution after cutover.
Bootstrap verification SHALL fail if any required generated orientation or license surface is absent.
FS0 SHALL distinguish repository content, desired GitHub operating state, observed GitHub state, authorized mutation, and verified resulting state.
Canonical bootstrap source roles SHALL keep FS0 realization input semantically distinct from successor Design Proposal input.
Governance, Conformance, and Assurance SHALL be the only authority-bearing keystones delegated by the Framework Contract.
No FS0 authority record SHALL acquire keystone authority implicitly.
Every accepted normative requirement SHALL have a stable machine-resolvable identity.
A missing bootstrap prerequisite SHALL stop bootstrap with a clear error before mutation.
GitHub mechanisms SHALL remain subordinate realizations and SHALL NOT define Governance, Conformance, or Assurance semantics.
Generated repository-orientation and license surfaces SHALL be deterministic for identical canonical inputs except explicitly declared variable installation-state fields.
Repository-orientation surfaces SHALL NOT become independent semantic owners.
Substantive bootstrap implementation SHALL be machine-resolvably distinct from the canonical bootstrap invocation surface.
Every bootstrap-installed successor Design Proposal seed SHALL have authority state none.
Each generated successor Design Proposal Markdown surface SHALL be a deterministic projection of its canonical structured proposal read representation.
Generated proposal Markdown SHALL NOT become an independent semantic owner.
Post-cutover FS0 SHALL require no semantic, template, generator, or script input from an external bootstrap environment.
The repository root SHALL be the complete structural governance boundary; no filesystem namespace beneath it SHALL remain outside structural governance.
Authority lifecycle_state SHALL support accepted, superseded, and withdrawn.
Requirement conformance_applicability SHALL be mechanical or none.
Requirement assurance_applicability SHALL be required or none.
Bootstrap state SHALL be candidate or cutover.
After cutover, the bootstrap cutover record SHALL be immutable except through later accepted authority that explicitly governs recovery or reconstruction.

The canonical agent-orientation surface SHALL prohibit treating technical write capability as authority, require exact candidate/evidence inspection before mutation, and require post-cutover persistent framework mutation to route through Governance.
FS0 SHALL NOT infer that one GitHub/repository state class has another state class's semantics merely because the states coincide.
Canonical bootstrap maintenance data SHALL provide the maintained source required to derive FS0 artifacts.
Successor Design Proposal source data SHALL remain machine-resolvably identifiable as a distinct canonical bootstrap source role.
Bootstrap-created maintained artifacts SHALL be generated from canonical maintenance data by separately identified generator implementation.
Generated FS0 read and operating surfaces SHALL NOT be independently maintained as canonical source.
Generation SHALL be deterministic for identical canonical inputs and explicitly declared variable inputs.
FS0 SHALL have one machine-resolvable canonical maintenance-data source role for generated FS0 artifacts.
FS0 semantic and realization choices required for generation SHALL be represented in canonical maintenance data rather than embedded in generator code.
Generator code SHALL NOT independently define FS0 normative semantics.
The FS0 generation source registry SHALL remain non-authoritative maintenance metadata.
Bootstrap source SHALL NOT replace an accepted generated read surface as authority when source and read surface disagree.
Post-cutover FS0 maintenance that modifies bootstrap source SHALL occur only through Governance-authorized work.
Each uniquely identified normative requirement SHALL express exactly one primary normative obligation.
Each normative requirement statement SHALL contain no more than 300 characters.
Material normative semantics SHALL NOT be omitted solely to satisfy the requirement-statement length bound.
Generated FS0 read surfaces SHALL be produced from canonical maintenance data by the identified generation implementation.
Every bootstrap-created maintained FS0 generated artifact SHALL be reproducible from its canonical maintenance data and identified generation implementation.
Each generated successor Design Proposal artifact SHALL be reproducible from canonical proposal source data and identified generation implementation.
Absence of applicable structural authorization for a filesystem object beneath the repository root SHALL mean deny.
No version-control, ignored, generated, cached, temporary, editor, build, tool, or runtime filesystem class SHALL receive implicit structural authorization.
Governed repository state SHALL determine exactly one canonical repository-structure configuration identity for the validation subject.
The operating substrate SHALL resolve the governed repository-structure configuration identity and SHALL NOT select among candidate configurations.

Caller preference, environment convention, implementation default, filename convention, search order, or fallback location SHALL NOT determine the canonical repository-structure configuration identity.
The canonical repository-structure configuration SHALL positively authorize its own filesystem object.
Repository-structure authorization SHALL distinguish required presence from permitted presence.
Authorizing a directory SHALL authorize only that directory object unless complete-subtree authorization is explicit.
Complete-subtree authorization SHALL authorize descendant paths without requiring individual descendant path declarations.
Complete-subtree authorization SHALL NOT override repository-wide structural invariants, including object-type admissibility.
Repository-structure authorization SHALL support ordinary files, directories, and symbolic links as explicit object types.
A filesystem object type unsupported by canonical repository-structure configuration semantics SHALL be denied.
A symbolic link SHALL be structurally authorized as the link object itself.
Repository-structure traversal SHALL NOT follow symbolic-link targets to discover descendants.
A symbolic-link target outside the repository root SHALL NOT enlarge the repository-structure governance boundary.
Bootstrap creation of a candidate filesystem object SHALL NOT independently grant structural authorization.
After candidate creation, bootstrap conventions, hard-coded paths, generator destination lists, and tool defaults SHALL NOT substitute for structural authorization.
The operating substrate SHALL resolve the canonical repository-structure configuration identity through a location-independent mechanism.
A structurally permitted filesystem object MAY be absent without causing repository-structure Conformance failure.
Implementation defaults, generated output lists, version-control ignore rules, workflow conventions, historical presence, and prior validation SHALL NOT independently authorize filesystem structure.
FS0 Governance SHALL implement Design Proposal -> Design -> Plan -> Build -> accepted repository state.
Design SHALL use Audit, Normalize, Accept; Plan SHALL use Analyze, Specify, Accept; Build SHALL use Implement, Verify, Accept.

Each governed Design, Plan, and Build work item SHALL record stable identity, predecessor, scope, material exclusions where applicable, candidate result, completion conditions, disposition, provenance, and bounded_authorization containing acceptance_actor.
Design SHALL consume a non-authoritative Design Proposal.
Plan SHALL consume accepted Design authority and define realization intent covering affected artifacts, Conformance work, Assurance work, dependencies, sequencing, and bounded Build scope.
Build SHALL consume an accepted Plan and implement only work authorized by that Plan.
Semantic defects SHALL route to Design, realization-intent defects to Plan, and implementation defects to Build.
Governance acceptance SHALL be explicit, attributable, traceable, candidate-specific, and realized by an authorized merge of an eligible governed pull request.
A Governance acceptance decision SHALL depend only on authority accepted before the candidate acquires authority produced by that acceptance.
A governed work item SHALL authorize only its explicit scope.
Each governed pull request SHALL identify exactly one governed-work issue; one governed-work issue MAY be realized through one or more pull requests.
A governed pull request MAY contain one or more commits; acceptance applies to the complete current pull-request candidate change set.
Required Conformance and Assurance SHALL gate merge eligibility for the complete current governed pull-request candidate.
Bootstrap acceptance SHALL be the authorized merge of the designated bootstrap-cutover pull request after passing bootstrap mechanical validation.
A merge candidate SHALL retain the exact accepted predecessor identities it depends on and SHALL be reevaluated if an applicable predecessor changes.
After cutover, refs/heads/main SHALL identify the accepted repository state resulting from the most recent authorized governed pull-request merge.
Closing, approval, workflow success, Conformance success, or Assurance findings SHALL NOT independently create acceptance; authorized merge of an eligible governed PR SHALL.
Initial bootstrap SHALL use one dedicated provenance issue and one designated bootstrap-cutover pull request targeting refs/heads/main.
For governed merge acceptance, the GitHub merge actor SHALL equal the governed issue bounded_authorization.acceptance_actor.
After FS0 cutover, every persistent framework change SHALL occur through FS0 Governance.
Design Normalize SHALL identify materially compound obligations, ambiguity, contradiction, duplication, inappropriate implementation leakage, and missing semantic ownership.

The installed proposal registry SHALL record proposal identity, order, installed path, lifecycle state, bootstrap provenance, authority state, reconstruction dependencies, and predecessor/successor identities where applicable.
Bootstrap-installed seed proposal registry records SHALL use lifecycle state available, bootstrap provenance bootstrap-seed, and authority state none.
The proposal registry SHALL let a fresh agent enumerate available unprocessed successor Design Proposals and reconstruction dependencies without chat history.
After cutover, a bootstrap-installed seed proposal SHALL NOT be mutated in place.
In the fixed FS0 GitHub binding, Design governed work SHALL use a GitHub issue.
FS0 SHALL make current governed work and accepted realization intent machine-resolvable from repository and GitHub state without chat history.
Design, Plan, and Build SHALL be represented as distinct governed work.
Design SHALL audit accepted authority and relevant repository state.
Design SHALL normalize persistent normative semantics into identified requirements.
Design acceptance SHALL be realized by authorized merge of an eligible Design pull request associated with its governed Design issue.
Plan SHALL NOT create or amend normative semantics.
Build SHALL produce required evidence, invoke required Conformance, perform required semantic audit, and continue governed work rather than merge when that audit is adverse.
Build SHALL NOT invent Design semantics or Plan intent.
Governance acceptance SHALL be authorized merge of the exact conforming governed pull request after semantic audit; that merge SHALL also record candidate Assurance satisfaction.
Completion or acceptance of governed work SHALL NOT independently authorize unrelated or successor work.
refs/heads/main SHALL change accepted repository state only through an authorized merge of an eligible governed pull request.
The external bootstrap provenance issue SHALL anchor exactly one designated bootstrap-cutover acceptance pull request and SHALL NOT be FS0-governed work.
Privileged mutation SHALL remain bounded by accepted authority, accepted Plan, and authorized Build scope.
No bootstrap-only mechanism SHALL independently create accepted framework state after cutover.
A correction to a bootstrap-installed seed proposal SHALL use a new or successor proposal with explicit lineage.
In the fixed FS0 GitHub binding, Plan governed work SHALL use a separate GitHub issue.
In the fixed FS0 GitHub binding, Build governed work SHALL use a separate GitHub issue.
In the fixed FS0 GitHub binding, candidate repository state SHALL use a Git branch plus exact commit SHA.
In the fixed FS0 GitHub binding, the candidate review surface SHALL use a pull request.
FS0 SHALL make the active Design work, initiating proposal, and candidate or accepted normative delta machine-resolvable without chat history.
FS0 SHALL make the exact revision under review, acceptance status, resulting accepted revision, and remaining unauthorized work machine-resolvable without chat history.
Design Normalize SHALL decompose materially compound obligations into separately identified requirements.
A governed PR SHALL NOT be accepted unless its exact current head has passing Conformance and a satisfactory applicable semantic-audit receipt before authorized merge.
A governed issue SHALL remain open until exact main has a satisfactory completion-audit receipt and relevant accepted PRs are Development-linked before authorized closure.
Every active accepted requirement SHALL have exactly one canonical Conformance correspondence declaring applicability mechanical or none.
Every mechanically applicable requirement SHALL resolve through its canonical correspondence to at least one executable assertion with stable assertion identity.
FS0 Conformance SHALL use assertion, support, evidence, and orchestration as its only required top-level primitive roles.
Assertion identity SHALL remain distinct from implementation-callable identity.
Every maintained Conformance primitive SHALL resolve to accepted normative authority.
Every executable assertion SHALL produce or resolve the evidence required by FS0 Conformance authority.
Every gating assertion SHALL be reachable from authorized canonical Conformance execution.
FS0 Conformance evidence SHALL demonstrate conforming-state acceptance, targeted-violation rejection, and execution of required assertions.
FS0 SHALL provide one canonical remotely runnable Conformance surface through GitHub Actions.
Before cutover, execution of candidate Conformance machinery SHALL be bootstrap mechanical verification evidence only.
Each installed Conformance correspondence record SHALL contain requirement_id, applicability, and assertion_ids.
In the fixed FS0 GitHub binding, canonical Conformance execution SHALL use the repository GitHub Actions workflow.
Multiple assertions MAY share one implementation only when assertion identities and provenance remain distinct.
FS0 SHALL provide one machine-resolvable canonical repository Conformance execution entry point invoked by the fixed FS0 GitHub workflow.
After cutover, the accepted Conformance execution surface SHALL be canonical unless later changed through Governance.
A Conformance correspondence with applicability mechanical SHALL contain at least one stable assertion identity.
A Conformance correspondence with applicability none SHALL contain an empty assertion_ids collection.
Conformance evidence in the fixed FS0 GitHub binding SHALL be a workflow or check result tied to the exact candidate commit SHA.
Every generated FS0 read surface SHALL be reproducible from its declared canonical maintenance inputs and identified generation implementation.
Canonical Conformance SHALL compare generated FS0 read surfaces with deterministic regeneration from their declared canonical source inputs.
A failed generation-correspondence check SHALL produce a Conformance defect.
Conformance SHALL reject a normative requirement statement longer than 300 characters.
Repository-structure Conformance SHALL evaluate the actual filesystem namespace beneath the repository root rather than only tracked, maintained, generated, or preclassified objects.
For every observed filesystem object beneath the repository root, Conformance SHALL resolve applicable structural authorization.
For every repository-structure configuration entry requiring presence, Conformance SHALL verify that the required filesystem object exists.

Repository-structure Conformance SHALL fail when governed state does not determine exactly one canonical structure-configuration identity or that identity does not resolve to exactly one configuration object.
Repository-structure Conformance failure SHALL identify unauthorized or missing filesystem objects sufficiently for correction.
Every active accepted requirement SHALL have exactly one canonical Assurance correspondence declaring applicability required or none.
A required Assurance obligation SHALL be resolvable through the governed issue or PR audit context and the applicable structured semantic-audit receipt for the exact subject.
FS0 Assurance SHALL support requirement-quality, ambiguity, contradiction, Design-fidelity, Plan-fidelity, Build-fidelity, Conformance-interpretation, and evidence-sufficiency review.
An adverse semantic-audit receipt SHALL block the applicable merge or issue closure until a later satisfactory receipt applies to the same exact subject.
Every Assurance audit receipt SHALL make governed work, exact subject, required obligations, outcome, evidence, material exclusions, and audit time resolvable.
A review subject SHALL NOT authorize its own Assurance review.
An Assurance audit conclusion SHALL be specific to the exact governed audit subject identified by its applicable structured receipt.
Each installed Assurance correspondence record SHALL contain requirement_id, applicability, and obligation_ids.
In the fixed FS0 GitHub binding, maintained Assurance provenance SHALL use governed issue and pull-request state/history rather than duplicate repository-tree case or finding artifacts.
An Assurance audit receipt or conclusion SHALL NOT independently create, amend, supersede, or withdraw persistent normative authority.
Persistent semantic change identified by Assurance SHALL route through Governance Design.
An Assurance correspondence with applicability required SHALL contain at least one stable review-obligation identity.
An Assurance correspondence with applicability none SHALL contain an empty obligation_ids collection.
Candidate and completion semantic-audit receipts, GitHub evidence/history, and their merge or issue-closure dispositions SHALL be remotely accessible.
Assurance requirement-quality review SHALL detect materially compound identified requirements and material semantic omission caused by statement-length compression.
